_comment: Per-step replacement copy for the base workflows, keyed by workflow name then step name. build_guide.py joins this with the extracted workflows.json (build/extract_workflows.py, gitignored) to render section 3 as a fix table: current text next to replacement, one copy button each. ai_builder_traps: The AI names a wait correctly ('Wait 24h before appointment') but sets the TYPE to 'For a set period of time' - which counts from the trigger, not the appointment. Verified 2026-08-14: flipped real appointments to no-show days early. For anything appointment- or event-date-anchored, open the step and confirm: Wait type = 'Until a scheduled date/time', What = Appointment (or the date field), When = Before/After + offset, 'If date already passed' = Continue.
The AI ignores naming instructions in the prompt. Rename every workflow and step after it builds - the numbered labels in the prompts are what you type in.
Asked to build something that already exists, the AI creates a second draft copy with broken references instead of editing. Check the workflow list first; delete duplicates in the UI (no API delete).
The AI's description reads step NAMES, not config. It will confidently describe what a mis-set wait step is named, not what it does. Verify by opening the step, never by the description.
If a published workflow misbehaves: set it to Draft FIRST, then fix data via API, then fix the config, then publish. Correcting data while it's still published re-triggers the bug.
